entry.prototype: Synthetic ELF vector table, MSP setup, interrupt masking, VTOR/FPU enable, data copy, BSS and DMA clearing, then owned application boot
entry.cache_contract: Original VM entry still rejects enabled caches. New stage-0 C helper preserves enabled/dirty caches and snapshots MPU/TCM state; it is not yet a loader-compatible reset entry.
unresolved: Factory loader handoff and copy extent
CPU clocks and FlexRAM bank ownership

port_requirements.HoldOutputs: Implemented stock low GPIO7 controls plus codec reset; analog meaning/pops unverified. All diagnostic TX remains zero.
port_requirements.StopAudio: Implemented SAI/DMAMUX/request shutdown, IRQ masking and bounded DMA ACTIVE checks. Failure prevents buffer writes/rebind.
port_requirements.PrepareMemory: Implemented OCRAM range/alignment and ROM-workspace exclusion, cache-line maintenance, ARM pointer mapping check. Ownership/MPU mapping unverified.
port_requirements.PreparePins: Implemented verified stock SAI1 and codec control pin subset; excludes FlexSPI pins. Board electrical behavior unverified.
port_requirements.AudioLdo_AnalogWrite_AnalogModify: Implemented bounded AI register transactions and recovered LDO sequence; tested against a semantic model, not silicon.
port_requirements.Write32: Restricted to reviewed clock/SAI registers with GPR0 field preservation.
port_requirements.DelayUnits: Resolved as microseconds; DWT-based bounded waits require explicitly validated CPU frequency. Counter is not reset by delays.
port_requirements.CodecReset_and_I2cBus: Implemented open-drain GPIO direction changes, PSR sampling, ACK/NACK/stretch timeouts and STOP-error propagation.
port_requirements.InstallDma: Implemented width-correct descriptors and RX0/TX16 normal request routing; rejects other active/requested DMA ownership.
port_requirements.PublishTx_AcquireRx: Implemented line-aligned cache maintenance and barriers. Inherited MPU/cache and physical bus ownership still unverified.
port_requirements.StartAudio: Implemented silent SAI/DMA enable sequence. IRQ remains masked; diagnostic polling only. Not physically tested.
port_requirements.ticks: DWT CYCCNT reads with no reset. Host steps are synthetic, not processor throughput evidence.

event_contract: Diagnostic poller independently snapshots RX/TX NEXT pointers, detects torn snapshots/alternation faults and acknowledges RX INT. Cannot count lost full-ring wraps or prove buffer ownership throughout processing. Physical IRQ/release deadline validation remains required.
diagnostic_policy: A2 output is kept in RAM for comparisons; all modeled TX slots remain zero. No unmute operation is exposed.
recovery: No ROM call, flash write, USB upload or fuse modification is implemented. Software ROM entry is a research lead requiring validated handoff and initially executable code.
